table.retrieve:
SELECT
	documentcode,
	Customer=A.Name,
	CustomerAliasName=A.AliasName,
	Item=I.Name,
	ItemAliasName=I.CustomICode,
	SalesMan=(SELECT SM.Name FROM SalesMan SM WHERE SM.SalesManCode = :ar_SManCode),
	S.Date, 
	S.InvCode,
	S.CustCode,
	S.Type,
	S.Qty,
	S.Bonus,
	S.Rate,
	S.ItemDiscPerc,
	S.ItemFlatDisc,
	S.InvDiscPerc,
	S.TAX
FROM
	Accounts A,
	Item I,
	(SELECT
		documentcode = 'SV-' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(SL.SaleInvCode, 10))), 
		SL.Date, 
		InvCode=SL.SaleInvCode,
		SL.CustCode,
		Type='S',
		SD.ICode,
		Qty=SUM(SD.LooseQty),
		Bonus=SUM(SD.BonusQty),
		Rate=SD.SalePrice,
		ItemDiscPerc=SD.DiscPerc,
		SD.ItemFlatDisc,
		InvDiscPerc=SL.DiscPerc,
		TAX=SUM((SD.UnitSalesTax * (SD.LooseQty + SD.BonusQty)) + 
			(SD.LooseQty * (SD.SalePrice - SD.ItemFlatDisc) * 
			(1 - SD.DiscPerc * .01) * (1 - SL.DiscPerc * .01) * SD.GSTPerc * 0.01))
	FROM
		SaleLedger SL, SaleDetail SD
	WHERE
		SL.Date BETWEEN :ar_StartDate AND :ar_EndDate AND
		SL.SManCode = :ar_SManCode AND
		SL.SaleInvCode = SD.SaleInvCode AND
		SD.ICode = :ar_ICode
	GROUP BY
		SL.SaleInvCode,
		SD.ICode,
		SL.Date, 
		SL.SaleInvCode,
		SL.CustCode,
		SD.SalePrice,
		SD.DiscPerc,
		SD.ItemFlatDisc,
		SL.DiscPerc
	UNION ALL
	SELECT
		documentcode = 'SV-' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(SL.SaleInvCode, 10))), 
		SL.Date, 
		InvCode=SL.SaleInvCode,
		SL.CustCode,
		Type='S',
		SD.ICode,
		Qty=SUM(SD.LooseQty),
		Bonus=SUM(SD.BonusQty),
		Rate=SD.SalePrice,
		ItemDiscPerc=SD.DiscPerc,
		SD.ItemFlatDisc,
		InvDiscPerc=SL.DiscPerc,
		TAX=SUM((SD.UnitSalesTax * (SD.LooseQty + SD.BonusQty)) + 
			(SD.LooseQty * (SD.SalePrice - SD.ItemFlatDisc) * 
			(1 - SD.DiscPerc * .01) * (1 - SL.DiscPerc * .01) * SD.GSTPerc * 0.01))
	FROM
		SaleLedger SL, SaleInvDetail SD
	WHERE
		SL.ImpactInventory = 'N' AND
		SL.Date BETWEEN :ar_StartDate AND :ar_EndDate AND
		SL.SManCode = :ar_SManCode AND
		SL.SaleInvCode = SD.SaleInvCode AND
		SD.ICode = :ar_ICode
	GROUP BY
		SL.SaleInvCode,
		SD.ICode,
		SL.Date, 
		SL.SaleInvCode,
		SL.CustCode,
		SD.SalePrice,
		SD.DiscPerc,
		SD.ItemFlatDisc,
		SL.DiscPerc
	UNION ALL
	SELECT
		documentcode = 'SR-' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(SL.SRInvCode, 10))), 
		SL.Date, 
		InvCode=SL.SRInvCode,
		SL.CustCode,
		Type='R',
		SD.ICode,
		Qty=-SUM(SD.LooseQty),
		Bonus=-SUM(SD.BonusQty),
		Rate=SD.SRPrice,
		ItemDiscPerc=SD.DiscPerc,
		ItemFlatDisc=0,
		InvDiscPerc=SL.DiscPerc,
		TAX=-SUM((SD.UnitSalesTax * (SD.LooseQty + SD.BonusQty)) + 
			(SD.LooseQty * SD.SRPrice * (1 - SD.DiscPerc * .01) * 
			(1 - SL.DiscPerc * .01) * SD.GSTPerc * 0.01))
	FROM
		SRLedger SL, SRDetail SD
	WHERE
		SL.Date BETWEEN :ar_StartDate AND :ar_EndDate AND
		SL.SManCode = :ar_SManCode AND
		SL.SRInvCode = SD.SRInvCode AND
		SD.ICode = :ar_ICode
	GROUP BY
		SL.SRInvCode,
		SD.ICode,
		SL.Date, 
		SL.CustCode,
		SD.SRPrice,
		SD.DiscPerc,
		SL.DiscPerc) S
WHERE
	S.ICode = I.ICode AND S.CustCode = A.AccCode
ORDER BY
	I.Name,
	S.Date,
	S.documentcode,
	S.InvCode,
	A.Name
